replacements.reason: Represent the projection matrix as the 4x4 object written by MTXPerspective and MTXOrtho instead of relying on the original stack-adjacent 16-byte pad plus 3x4 matching-build layout.

Preserve GALE01 0x8000DC84, 0x8000DC8C, and 0x8000DC9C as three explicit binary32 fmadds operations. The supported host disables implicit contraction, so the unadapted expression rounds the multiply and add separately and diverges by one binary32 step during wall reflection. Use Slippi binary64 intermediate rounding before binary32 storage; direct host fmaf differs at double-rounding boundaries.
Declare the shared Slippi multiply-add rounding helper.
